parameters.name: AsyncRequestId
parameters.description: The request ID.

parameters.name: ClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the request client.

parameters.name: ClientUa
parameters.description: The client type.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: DatabaseName
parameters.description: The database name.

parameters.name: EffectRowRange
parameters.description: The range of affected rows.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the alert log. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: ExecuteTimeRange
parameters.description: The range of execution time.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the asset instance.

parameters.name: IpType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:

- **default** (default): non-Alibaba Cloud service

- **aliyun**: Alibaba Cloud service

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese.
- **en_us**: English.

parameters.name: LoadWhiteList
parameters.description: Specifies whether to load the whitelist status.

parameters.name: LogQueryOpJson
parameters.description: The JSON string that specifies whether the query conditions are included.

parameters.name: LogSource
parameters.description: The data source.

parameters.name: MemberAccount
parameters.description: The UID of the member accounts.

parameters.name: Message
parameters.description: The message content.

parameters.name: OperateType
parameters.description: The operation type.

parameters.name: OssObjectKey
parameters.description: The key of the OSS object.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The name of the product to which the data asset belongs. Valid values: **MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, RDS**, and more.

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description:
The ID that corresponds to the product name to which the data object belongs. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute
- **2**: OSS
- **3**: ADB-MYSQL
- **4**: TableStore
- **5**: RDS
- **6**: SELF_DB
- **7**: PolarDB-X
- **8**: PolarDB
- **9**: ADB-PG
- **10**: OceanBase
- **11**: MongoDB
- **25**: Redis

parameters.name: RuleAggQuery
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform an aggregate query.

parameters.name: RuleCategory
parameters.description: The rule type.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the audit policy.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the audit policy.

parameters.name: SqlText
parameters.description: The content of the SQL statement.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the alert log, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username.
